\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{ആഗ്രഹം} (āgrahaṁ)}{ആഗ്രഹം (āgrahaṁ)}]{\ml{ആഗ്രഹം} (āgrahaṁ) — a wish, a desire}

\label{lesson:ML-C145-agraham}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a cause, then the Malayalam for on account of.

In casual talk, what do many speakers say instead of \emph{śubha rātri}? (The English \textquotedblleft{}good night.\textquotedblright{})
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{ആഗ്രഹം}}
\textbf{\ml{ആഗ്രഹം}} — \emph{āgrahaṁ} — \textquotedblleft{}a wish, a desire\textquotedblright{}.

  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{āgrahaṁ}
